title: The Eyeflash Miracles
author: Gene Wolfe
note: conf=0.95; Proposed identification verified as correct on all fields. "The Eyeflash Miracles" (1976) is a Nebula-nominated NOVELLA by Gene Wolfe, first published in the anthology Future Power (ed. Dann & Dozois, 1976), reprinted in The Best Science Fiction of the Year #6 (1977) and in Wolfe's collections The Island of Doctor Death and Other Stories and Other Stories (1980), The Best of Gene Wolfe (2009), and The Very Best of Gene Wolfe. It is genuinely standalone: ISFDB title record #41421 shows no series assignment, and in ISFDB contents listings it appears without any series bracket, unlike neighboring Wolfe stories that are tagged (e.g. [The Fifth Head of Cerberus], [Archipelago]). It is not part of the loosely associated "Doctor Death / Doctor Island / Doctor of Death Island" grouping. Caveat: this file is a standalone novella rather than a full-length book, and it carries no ISBN, consistent with the EPUB metadata.
